post.caption:
Active noise cancelling does not block anything. A microphone samples the incoming sound, the electronics generate an inverted waveform, and the two sum to near silence in your ear. The catch is that it has microseconds to predict what comes next. A steady engine drone is low frequency and endlessly repetitive, so it vanishes. Speech is high frequency and unpredictable, so it does not. That is the whole reason the plane goes quiet and the conversation does not.
